content.short: 0xProcessing is a crypto payment gateway for businesses that want to accept TON and 85+ other assets.
content.description: 0xProcessing is a merchant payment gateway for crypto checkout, invoices, and business payouts. Its official site describes support for BTC and more than 85 cryptocurrencies, with low-fee processing and payment tools for e-commerce, SaaS, iGaming, proxy services, and other online businesses. The TON relevance comes from using it as a payment processor, not as a personal wallet. Start accepting BTC and 85+ cryptocurrencies with a secure, low-fee, best-in-class payment gateway built for real business needs.
